name: agent-board
description: Autonomous local Kanban for coding agents: markdown cards, souls/roles, local-first triage, capacity-safe dispatch, attachable sessions.

interface.shortDescription: Turn goals into routed Kanban cards that agents execute unattended.
interface.longDescription: Product-manager control of a local agent board: raw ideas are specified, split, and routed to role souls by a local-first triage model; a dispatcher runs codex/claude/local workers under atomic capacity controls; cards are markdown files you can edit by hand.
defaultPrompt: Put these goals on the board and route them.
What are my agents working on, and what did the board spend today?
This card keeps blocking — re-spec it and re-route it.
